title: HIBP Alert-to-Password-Change Latency
dataSources: Breach alerts (`hibp:alert`), password age snapshots (`passwordage:account`), backup restore tests (`backuprestore:test`), and DNS leak checks (`dnsleak:check`).
app: Personal security telemetry from Have I Been Pwned, password-age exports, backup restore drills, and DNS leak checks sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hibp:alert
| search remediation_hr=*
| stats avg(remediation_hr) as avg_remediation_hr perc90(remediation_hr) as p90_remediation_hr count as samples by identity_name
| sort 0 - avg_remediation_hr
description: Measures time from breach alert to password change by identity.
value: Response latency matters because the risk window after a breach alert is where the value of monitoring is proven.
implementation: Send the relevant duration field for time from breach alert to password change to `index=personal` and review both average and p90 latency instead of relying on single examples.
visualization: Table of average and p90 time from breach alert to password change.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how long time from breach alert to password change usually takes, so slowdowns are obvious instead of anecdotal.
